description:
• About our brand and products: 

Aromadd is revolutionizing the world of aromatherapy by seamlessly blending cutting-edge technology with the purity of nature. We are dedicated to providing our customers with a waterless, convenient, and highly effective scent experience.

Our main product lines include:

  • Waterless Aroma Diffusers: Utilizing advanced cold-air diffusion technology, our diffusers require no water and no heat. This method ensures that the 100% natural, therapeutic properties of essential oils are fully preserved and dispersed in their purest form. They are modern, portable, and ideal for homes, offices, and travel.

  • Premium Pure Essential Oils: We source the finest botanicals globally to create high-quality, unadulterated essential oils. Our range offers diverse benefits and aromas to guarantee the best possible aromatherapy results.

Aromadd is more than a product—it's a commitment to a clean, efficient, and sophisticated lifestyle.


• What makes us different:

Aromadd's unique value proposition provides affiliates with strong selling points:

  1. Maximum Purity & Potency: By eliminating water and heat, our diffusers prevent the dilution and degradation of essential oils, delivering a more intense, pure aroma and enhanced therapeutic benefits compared to traditional diffusers.

  2. Ultimate Convenience & Cleanliness: Say goodbye to the hassle of constantly adding water and scrubbing mineral buildup. Our diffusers are plug-and-play and virtually maintenance-free, significantly improving the user experience.

  3. Versatility for Any Space: Our waterless design does not increase indoor humidity, making it perfect for humid climates, sensitive individuals, and effectively scenting larger areas quickly.

  4. Sleek Design & Modern Aesthetic: Our products boast a minimalist, high-end design that appeals to consumers looking for stylish, high-tech additions to their modern living spaces.


• How affiliates can earn: 


  • Attractive Commission Rate: Earn a generous 10% commission on every successful sale generated through your unique affiliate link.

  • High Earning Potential: Our diffusers are premium items, and essential oils are a high-repeat purchase product, ensuring potential for high average order value and recurring revenue.

  • High Conversion: Our products solve common pain points (water, cleaning, dilution), offering a clear and compelling upgrade that drives strong purchase conversion rates among informed buyers.


• How to promote us: 


Aromadd is a perfect fit for audiences interested in Health & Wellness, Aromatherapy, Smart Home Tech, Efficient Living, and Minimalist Design.

  1. Product Comparisons & Demonstrations: Create engaging videos or blog posts directly comparing the convenience and scent quality of a waterless diffuser vs. a traditional ultrasonic one.

  2. Lifestyle Integration: Showcase the products in various real-life settings (e.g., home office focus, bedside table, car travel), emphasizing convenience and portability.

  3. Educational Content: Educate your audience on the power of pure essential oils and how Aromadd ensures they receive the full therapeutic benefits. Position the products as the solution for better sleep, stress relief, or air purification.

  4. Exclusive Offers: Use your unique affiliate link and leverage any special promotions or exclusive discounts to encourage immediate purchase from your audience.


• Other information: 


  • Cookie Duration: We offer a 30-day cookie window, ensuring you get credit for sales made up to 30 days after a user clicks your link.

  • Marketing Assets: You will receive full access to a library of high-quality product images, videos, and creative banners to support your promotions.

  • Integrity and Compliance: We require all partners to promote Aromadd authentically and ethically, ensuring all claims are truthful and aligned with our brand values.

Join the Aromadd Affiliate Program today and help us spread the purest form of scent!
